label: LOCAL-SIM
item: B7 browser wallet check with a real MetaMask extension

environment.browser: Google Chrome with MetaMask (owner's), driven by Claude in Chrome

roles.owner: added the local network (chain 31337) in MetaMask, created a fresh account for the test, approved every MetaMask prompt (connect, network switch, signature, approve, fund, release)
roles.claude: created throwaway users, job and contract through the API; clicked the page buttons; funded the fresh account with Anvil ETH and simulated USDC; sent the freelancer's on-chain submit by Anvil impersonation (its throwaway key was not kept); read UI, backend and chain state

steps.step: link attempt, MetaMask prompt closed or rejected
steps.ui: Bạn đã từ chối yêu cầu trong ví. Chưa có gì được gửi.

steps.step: link attempt, MetaMask on a network other than 31337
steps.ui: Ví đang ở sai mạng. Hãy chuyển ví sang đúng mạng rồi thử lại.
Nạp tiền ký quỹ: Đã chốt, contract 'Đang hiệu lực', milestone 'Đã nạp tiền'
steps.backend: fund FINALIZED businessApplied, chain FUNDED, contract ACTIVE / FUNDED

steps.step: freelancer submission recorded and anchored (API + impersonated send, not MetaMask)

steps.ui: Giải ngân: Đã chốt; 'Đã giải ngân cho Freelancer'; workflow Approved
steps.backend: release FINALIZED businessApplied, chain RELEASED, contract COMPLETED, milestone RELEASED, job COMPLETED

observations: The button 'Chọn ký quỹ Solana' is still shown on the contract page although the Solana rail is disabled (R13); a click would fail closed. UI clean-up candidate, not changed.

After the release, the legacy section 'Giải ngân hợp đồng' shows 'Chưa có bản ghi giải ngân để xác nhận. Đang đối soát với Marketplace.' on an Avalanche-rail contract that is already released on chain; confusing wording, not changed.
Signing in as the same user through the API ends the browser session of that user (single session per account); not a defect.
The freelancer notifications list read through the API was empty after the release; not investigated in this run (the drive driver records settlement notifications separately).
notCovered: rejecting a transaction in MetaMask (covered by the test-double run of 2026-11-05)
dispute, R12 settlement and arbiter paths with MetaMask
